House roof collapse in Dabra kills mother and son

In Dabra, Gwalior, the roof of a mud house collapsed overnight, trapping seven people under the debris. A mother and her two-year-old son died in the incident. The child's father and two daughters were among those injured. Local residents alleged negligence during treatment at the hospital for the injured.
